scene.ko: 체크인하며 요금에 아침 식사가 포함됐는지, 와이파이 연결 방법, 늦은 체크아웃을 묻는다.

lines.en: Yes, I booked a double room for three nights. The name is Park.
alt: Yes, I have a double room for three nights under Park.

lines.en: Thank you, Ms. Park. Could I have a credit card for incidentals?
lines.ko: 감사합니다, 박 고객님. 부대 비용(미니바 등)을 위해 신용카드를 받을 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Sure. Is breakfast included in the rate?
lines.ko: 네. 요금에 아침 식사가 포함돼 있나요?
alt: Sure. Does the price include breakfast?

lines.en: Yes, it's served in the restaurant on the first floor from 6:30.
Great. And how do I connect to the Wi-Fi?
alt: Good. How can I use the Wi-Fi?

lines.en: The password is on the back of your key card.
Perfect. Would it be possible to check out a little late on Friday?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 금요일에 조금 늦게 체크아웃할 수 있을까요?
alt: Perfect. Can I check out a bit late on Friday?

lines.en: We can do 1 p.m. at no charge. Enjoy your stay.
lines.ko: 오후 1시까지는 무료로 해 드릴 수 있어요. 즐거운 시간 보내세요.

expressions.note: free of charge 와 같은 뜻
